Strategy note

Insights

  • Each messaging conversation cost RM15.95, RM24.05 under our RM40 target and about half of September's, as the budget focused into what works after September's testing.
  • Sales more than doubled to 34, and return on ad spend (ROAS) is at 2.56x, up from RM1.40 in September.
  • The quality rate reduced to 38.9% as leads grew 60% with scale, yet qualified leads still rose from 99 to 119, so this reflects growth, not weaker performance.
  • Audiences beyond our core are already responding: men converted at RM15.79 per conversation (women RM16.25), and the 45+ group brought over half of all conversations at RM14.64 each.

Recommendations

  • Test a few more interest audiences alongside our broad targeting to find the next pocket of low-cost conversations.
  • Launch a male audience angle with its own creative, since men are already converting at a similar cost without one.
  • We'd recommend a Kosen-focused test, run as its own campaign so the results stay clean and easy to read.
  • Build a dedicated angle for the 45+ group, who already bring over half of our conversations at a lower cost than younger groups.
  • Keep creatives fresh with new versions of our two winners, which brought in 87% of conversations, including vertical Reels cuts and a shorter edit of our top video.
